NewsFeedTexts.m_Text: Vanilla+ 1PP PVP on Chernarus. Survive first. One trading post. Raid weekends: Friday 18:00 through Monday 06:00 (server time).
Coastal spawns only: Svetloyarsk, Berezino, Elektro, Chernogorsk. Insight Cell jobs are at Green Mountain — that area is not a safezone.
There is a single Insight Trading Post (custom build). Traders are for food, meds, ammo toppers, and repairs — not full loadouts. Sell prices are intentionally low.
Bases can be raided Fri 18:00–Mon 06:00. Outside that window Expansion raid tools will not work. Build like you expect company on the weekend.
Scarce contested caches can ping near NWAF / VMC when enough survivors are online. Bring friends. Expect infected. Do not treat them like a free endgame printer.
Talk to Mira at Green Mountain for the Dead Drop chain. Board jobs unlock after Eyes Only. Rewards are survival tools — the map still has to be earned.
